tasks.title: Lock Version-2 Execution Contracts
tasks.description: Focused tests define the required task fields, deterministic rejection behavior, producer obligations, and unchanged compatibility before implementation changes.
acceptance_criteria: Positive fixtures prove that version-2 tasks with non-empty acceptance_criteria and verification arrays validate.
Negative fixtures cover absent, non-array, empty, non-string, and whitespace-only values with deterministic issue codes and exact JSON paths.
Repeated validation and CLI fixtures prove stable issue ordering and unchanged exit-code behavior.
Producer-contract tests require the PRD template, /create, and /plan to emit and preserve both arrays.
Version-1 and existing graph-producer baseline tests remain green before production changes.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="version 2 task execution contracts|graph producers emit executable task contracts" .pi/tests/task-graph.test.ts .pi/tests/skill-system.test.ts

node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="validates version 1 and version 2 graphs|graph producers use one canonical task graph" .pi/tests/task-graph.test.ts .pi/tests/skill-system.test.ts
tasks.expected_verification_state: The new contract tests fail only because version-2 execution fields and producer obligations are not yet enforced; retained baseline tests pass.

tasks.title: Enforce Version-2 Task Contracts
tasks.description: The task-graph validator rejects incomplete acceptance and verification arrays with deterministic issues while preserving version-1 and scheduling behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Version-2 decoding preserves acceptance_criteria and verification arrays for validation and downstream consumers.
Missing, malformed, empty, non-string, and whitespace-only contract values produce deterministic GraphIssue codes and exact paths.
Version-1 tasks remain valid without the new fields.
Existing state, evidence, dependency, conflict, file-overlap, frontier, descendant, and CLI behavior is unchanged.
Validation treats verification strings as inert data and starts no subprocess.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="version 2 task execution contracts|validates version 1 and version 2 graphs|validation rejects malformed scheduling and evidence field types" .pi/tests/task-graph.test.ts
for f in .pi/artifacts/*/tasks.json; do node --experimental-strip-types .pi/scripts/task-graph.ts validate "$f"; done

tasks.title: Align Canonical Graph Producers
tasks.description: The PRD template and /create and /plan guidance consistently emit and preserve the version-2 execution contract enforced by the validator.
acceptance_criteria: The PRD task format requires at least one observable acceptance criterion and one repository-supported verification command per task.
/create validation and version-2 conversion preserve both non-empty arrays.
/plan graph refinement preserves stable IDs and both execution-contract arrays.
Producer guidance states that structural validation does not prove semantic adequacy or command success.
tasks.json remains the sole scheduling authority and no fifth lifecycle artifact is introduced.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="graph producers emit executable task contracts|graph producers use one canonical task graph|PRD success criteria describe externally observable behavior" .pi/tests/skill-system.test.ts

tasks.title: Verify Integrated Enforcement
tasks.description: The validator, producer contracts, retained graphs, and full test suite pass together without broadening the enforcement claim or modifying out-of-scope state.
acceptance_criteria: All focused task-graph and producer-contract tests pass with zero skips.
Every retained artifact graph validates without migration.
The complete retained test suite passes.
Cross-artifact frontier reporting leaves .active byte-identical.
The final diff is limited to the six declared implementation paths and contains no dependency, runtime-state, or lifecycle-artifact proliferation.
verification: for f in .pi/artifacts/*/tasks.json; do node --experimental-strip-types .pi/scripts/task-graph.ts validate "$f"; done
